strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Cross Gate Watch Fleet Flagship - Strong Ark
Damn the Zovorg, warping in at a time like this...!@And taking up position right there, of all places.
So watching the Cross Gate from a distance@has come back to bite us.
CGP readings increasing further! They'll reach@burst-phenomenon levels in about 600 seconds!
(With the Cross Gate at their backs,@we can't attack carelessly. We'll have to@buy time until the Steel Dragons arrive.)
This is Colonel Humphrey Innes of the Earth Federation@Space Force's Cross Gate Watch Fleet. Attention,@Zovorg forces. Leave this area immediately.
Understand that if you do not comply,@we have the right to strike first.
My, my, how dutiful of them to say all that.@Looks like they really can't attack us here~
Lady Iradoya, the Steel Dragons@are entering this area.
Ufufu, the whole cast is here now~
(In this situation... You've got to be joking, really.)
This is Brigadier General Miles Boothroyd,@commander of the 1st Special Independent Unit.@Attention, Cross Gate Watch Fleet.
We are under special orders from the Joint Chiefs@to carry out an operation near the Cross Gate.@Fall back and keep watch on the outer perimeter.
General Miles, this is Colonel Humphrey.@What does your operation involve?
I can't tell you that without@Marshal Gaspar Gilan's permission.
Damn Golaikunru, taking up@such a troublesome position...
It'd make things easy if that Cross Gate@connected to the Endless Frontier.
If you're telling me to go inside and search for clues,@I shall have to most politely decline-ish.@It's super-mega bothersome.
I know.@The Shiun Boys are trying to close it, after all.
Yes... If anything, I'm the one who should@apologize for dragging you all into this.
...I meant to fight the Fury and avenge my parents...@but after learning the truth,@I've changed my mind.
What Touya said to me inside Gaw-La Furia... What can@we, the children of Earthlings and Fury, do,@and what should we accomplish...
I'll find that answer. I think that's how I can repay@the feelings of the mother who gave birth to me@and the father who watched over me...
So I'll work with you. I'll keep riding@this Granteed Dracodeus.@Is that all right, Touya?
Of course, Katia.@I need your support.
So, Shana-Mia...@How do we seal the Cross Gate?
Hone your mind, and use the Cytron System@to awaken the soul of Fureim, the god of creation,@that dwells within the Throne Unit.
Got it... Let's give it a shot, Katia.
...I meant to fight the Fury and@avenge my dad and mom...@but after learning the truth, I've changed my mind.
What Touya said to me inside Gaw-La Furia...@What can we, born between Earthlings and Fury,@do, and what should we do...
I'll find that answer. I think that's how I can repay@the feelings of the mom who gave birth to me@and the dad who watched over me...
So I'll help out. I'll keep riding@this Granteed Dracodeus.@That okay, Touya?
Of course, Tenia.@I need your support.
Got it... Let's give it a shot, Tenia.
I... After learning the truth Shana-Mia@told us, I changed my mind.
What Touya told me inside Gaw-La Furia...@What can we, born between Earthlings and Fury,@do, and what should we do...
I'll find that answer. I think that's how I can repay@the feelings of the mother who gave birth to me@and the father who watched over me.
So I'll work with you.@I'll keep riding this one.@Is that all right, Touya?
Of course, Melua.@I need your support.
Hone your mind, and use the Cytron System@to awaken the soul of Fureim, the god of creation,@that dwells within the Throne Unit.
Got it... Let's give it a shot, Melua.
Relay to all mobile units.@Do not let the enemy get close@to the Granteed Dracodeus.
Commander, how long will it take@to seal the Cross Gate?
Apparently, they won't know until they try.
(We're counting on you, all three of you...!)
Now, now, what will they do~?
Their position... Are they@trying to take the Cross Gate?
If so, why they moved now is a mystery.@If a burst phenomenon occurs, they'll be@the first ones to get hit...
If everyone in those machines is a bioroid,@they may be pawns meant to secure this area.
To the Golaikunru mobile force.@I am Gayattoba Stecca,@aide to the Privy Council Envoy.
Military action in the Earth Sphere without@Privy Council permission is forbidden.@State your affiliation, name and rank.
I'm Iradoya Kujuah. A mercenary of the Golaikunru.
Gayattova, dear, I've heard about you.@From Kinaha over here~
Kinaha...? Kinaha Sokonko?!@He should've been deported home and imprisoned!@Why is he here?!
Kinaha... That's the guy who chased us@when Sally and I made contact with the Steel Dragons.
By the way, as for our objective...
That witch is messing with us!
Major Kai, I believe they're buying time@for some purpose. The situation is dangerous,@but we should keep them in check.
Right. We need to protect@the Granteed Dracodeus, too.
Eleve 1 to all units! Commence attack!@But don't go too close to the Cross Gate!
CGP readings rising rapidly!@Reaching burst-phenomenon levels in 10 seconds!
Impossible, it's too fast!@Can't the Granteed Dracodeus@seal the Cross Gate yet?!
(No response...@And yet the Cytron Control System@is functioning normally...)
I'm afraid... our power isn't enough.
You mean we can't close@the Gate as we are now...?!
Pull all units back at once!@Prepare to deploy the energy field!
CGP readings have reached burst-phenomenon levels!
Is a C-Cross Gate Burst about to happen?!
To think it'd happen sooner on their end...!
W-We should evacuate at once, too!
Before that, let's give them a warning.
Confirming 20-meter-class protrusions@on the Cross Gate's boundary surface! Two of them!
The Valsione R is here too!
But Masaki and the others went back to <La Gias>.@So why did they come out of the Cross Gate...?!
But that unit was absorbed by the <Adamatron>@in the final battle of the Sealing War...!
Could it be like the Ares Geist...?
Even so, why is it with Masaki and the others?
...It seems we made it through the boundary space.
Yeah... Your guess that we'd come out@in the surface world if we went through@the Cross Gate was right on.
I got it in my head, but I was still sweating@over whether we'd really make it.
Hey, Ryusei. Long time no see.
Huh? You guys went back to La Gias@just the other day, didn't you?
Oh, right. Up here on the surface,@not much time has passed, unlike in La Gias.
And why is the Galilnagant... Is that@Amala piloting it...?!
There are a number of circumstances.@She is currently cooperating with us.
I know it's hard to believe, but it's true.@Not that we've got time to explain the details.
S-Something like this...@Th-This is the worst... the worst possible outcome...!
Master, that unit...@Isn't that the guy@from the Golaikunru?
After everything he went through,@he came flying back to the Earth Sphere...@The man never learns.
Well, this is an unexpected development...
Gravity quake readings near the Cross Gate!@Someone is space-jumping in!
Well, well, what a stroke of luck.
Oh my, even Lord Gomoudokka is here.
With the whole cast gathered like this,@I can't just sit back and watch.
Hello, everyone. A pleasure to meet you.@I am Gomoudokka Golaikunru.
Golaikunru... Bearing that name, does that@make you their manager, of sorts?
Well, you can think of it that way.
Family circumstances, you see.@More importantly, Shu Shirakawa... I'm glad to meet you.
Have you come to avenge Quepalok Namo?
I couldn't care less how many mercenaries die.@Besides, I'm also very interested@in your Granzon.
What do you mean, also?!@Like it's some kind of afterthought!@How rude!
What's wrong? Won't you bring out your trump card?@You showed Quepalok the Neo Granzon, didn't you?
If that is your wish, I'll show it to you.
Iradoya, Kinaha. You two pull back.@I'll take care of them.
Just a little entertainment before the main event.@That's all right, isn't it?
(So I got out of fighting@Shu Shirakawa...)
Now then, let me see what the famous Granzon@and its friends are capable of.
Tch, lumping us together like that!@Shiro, how's the Imitation Ritual@Converter holding up?
Thanks to going through the boundary space,@it's got plenty of charge, meow.
You can move like before and use all your weapons...@but there's no telling how long it'll last, meow.
So we're on a time limit.
Masaki, the Cybuster currently@lacks the protection of the spirits...
It is absorbing the malice that drifted in the@boundary space with the Imitation Ritual Converter@and converting it into power.
So malice builds up in the Cybuster, right?@I know.
Yes... Unless it's purified afterward,@your Prana and the Cybuster's attributes@could turn negative.
So whatever you do, don't push yourself.
Heh, never thought you'd worry about me.@You don't have to nag. I'll hold back.
If anything happened to the Cybuster,@it'd all be for nothing.
Very well. Then let's go, Amala.
Look who's talking! Seriously, don't overdo it!
...What's the status of the Cross Gate?
CGP readings are settling down.@No signs of a burst phenomenon.
Does that mean the crisis has passed...?
Shana-Mia, we couldn't seal the Cross Gate, but@we can't just stand by and watch. We're going too.
Now then, let the entertainment begin...!
...Heh heh, impressive.@Seems nothing else is coming out, so I'd say it's time.
Things are only just beginning.@I enjoyed fighting you. See you.
All enemy signals in the combat area are gone!
Gomoudokka Golaikunru...@Who on earth is that man...?
Heh heh heh... Impressive. There was plenty@I couldn't learn just by looking at data.
That was truly fun entertainment.@It was worth coming all the way to Earth.
Well then, keep up the good work. See you.
Chika, did Gomoudokka eject from his unit?
No, it didn't look like it.
Eita, what's the CGP reading from the Cross Gate?
It hasn't dropped to pre-Cross Gate Burst@levels, but it seems to have stabilized.
Were those earlier readings a sign that the@Granzon and Cybuster were about to appear?
We'll ask Dr. Shu Shirakawa for details. The situation@is still unpredictable, so keep a strict all-around@watch. Units needing resupply or repair, return now.
Masaki, Lüne, Amala,@you'd best land on the Hagane.
N-No, it's not that! Powerful gravity quake@readings right above the Cross Gate!
It's not mobile weapon or battleship class!@Something much larger seems to be warping in!!
